dialog.english:
ere having an adventure
in the Digimon world, it hasn't
even been a day here...
dialog.translation:
tenemos una aventura en el
Mundo Digimon y aquí no ha
pasado ni un día...

dialog.english: it hasn't even been a day here...
dialog.translation: aquí no ha pasado ni un día...

dialog.english:
Palmon! You're supposed to be a
stuffed animal right now! Don't
talk!
dialog.translation:
Palmon! Se supone que ahora
eres un peluche! No hables!

dialog.english: Nooooooooo! I'm so bored...
Nooooooooo! I'm so bored...

Mimi! If you don't hurry up, we're
gonna be late!
dialog.translation:
Mimi! Si no te das prisa, vamos
a llegar tarde!

dialog.english: I'm comiiiiiiiiing!
I'm comiiiiiiiiing!

If they find out that you're a
Digimon, everyone will make a big
fuss over you!
dialog.translation:
Si descubren que eres un
Digimon, se van a montar un
lío tremendo contigo!

dialog.english: Got it. I'll be quiet.
Mimi, over there!
That's...
One of Vamdemon's minions!

Why hasn't anyone else noticed
him?!
dialog.translation:
Cómo nadie más se ha dado
cuenta?!

dialog.english:
We're the only ones who can see
him! He hasn't completely
materialized here!
dialog.translation:
Somos los únicos que podemos
verlo! No se ha materializado
del todo aquí!

dialog.english: No way!

We have to lure him somewhere
else! There are too many people
around!
dialog.translation:
Hay que llevarlo a otro
sitio! Hay demasiada gente
por aquí!

dialog.english: There are too many people around!

Papa, Mama! I have to go somewhere
for a bit!
dialog.translation:
Papá, Mamá! Voy a un sitio,
vuelvo enseguida!

dialog.english: Go...where?
Here! Come over here!

We won't have to worry about being
spotted over here!
dialog.translation:
Aquí no tendremos que
preocuparnos por si nos ven!

dialog.english: I'm leaving this to you, Palmon!
dialog.translation: Te lo dejo a ti, Palmon!

dialog.english: Okay!
That was close...

I can't believe he appeared here,
of all places. Ah!
dialog.translation:
No puedo creer que apareciera
aquí precisamente. Ah!

dialog.english: What's wrong, Mimi?

We were running so much that the
swimsuit Mama bought me got all
messed up...
dialog.translation:
De tanto correr, el bañador
que me compró Mamá se ha
estropeado...

dialog.english: Mimi...
You took so long!
Did you go somewhere?

Yeah! I was chasing someone I
thought I knew...
dialog.translation:
Sí! Seguía a alguien que
creía conocer...

dialog.english:
But I guess they just looked
really similar.
dialog.translation:
Pero supongo que solo se
parecían mucho.

dialog.english:
Okay, then. Let's go to the
movies!

I remember, this was the movie
theater we went to on our first
date...
dialog.translation:
Me acuerdo, este es el cine
al que fuimos en nuestra
primera cita...

dialog.english: Yeah, yeah! We were watching...
Yeah, yeah! We were watching...
Yeah, yeah! We were watching...

I thought you'd be really upset,
but you seem to be cheerful.
dialog.translation:
Pensé que estarías muy
disgustada, pero pareces animada.

dialog.english:
Well, yeah. It'd be nice if I
could buy another swimsuit, but...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, sí. Estaría bien poder
comprar otro bañador, pero...

dialog.english:
Going out with Mama and Papa is
something money can't buy.
dialog.translation:
Salir con Mamá y Papá es algo
que no compra el dinero.

dialog.english:
Huh, Mimi, you've gotten pretty
mature.
dialog.translation:
Vaya, Mimi, qué madura te
has vuelto.

dialog.english: Eheheh... I'm just joking around.
